entries.en: A one-horse cart carried the sacks from the mill to the village.
entries.zh: 一辆单马拉的车把那些袋子从磨坊运到村里。

entries.en: The sealed sample of phosphoric acid was labelled with the date of collection.
entries.zh: 那份密封的磷酸样品标有采集日期。

entries.en: Our geography teacher used plate tectonics to explain the formation of mountain ranges.
entries.zh: 我们的地理老师用板块构造学说解释山脉的形成。

entries.en: By lunchtime, the pot roast was tender enough to pull apart with a fork.
entries.zh: 到午饭时，炖肉已经软得可以用叉子拨开了。

entries.en: A small diesel engine serves as the prime mover for the pump.
entries.zh: 一台小型柴油发动机充当这台泵的原动机。

entries.en: The workshop shutters can be raised by remote control from the office.
entries.zh: 车间的卷帘门可以在办公室内通过遥控升起。

entries.en: The crew will rig out the empty van as a mobile workshop.
entries.zh: 工作人员将把那辆空货车装配成一个移动工作间。

entries.en: The archivist spent weeks trying to root out the missing letter.
entries.zh: 那位档案管理员花了几个星期，试图找出那封失踪的信。

entries.en: They disagree about almost everything but somehow manage to rub along as neighbours.
entries.zh: 他们几乎事事意见不合，却不知怎么还是能勉强以邻居的身份相处。

entries.en: A rubber plant stood beside the window, its broad leaves coated with dust.
entries.zh: 窗边立着一株橡胶植物，宽大的叶片上积了一层灰。

entries.en: A quick run-through of the draft revealed a missing paragraph near the end.
entries.zh: 把草稿从头快速读了一遍后，发现结尾附近少了一段。

entries.en: The carpenter could not screw up the clamp any tighter.
entries.zh: 那个木匠没法把夹具拧得更紧了。

entries.en: With the best room already booked, we settled for second best.
entries.zh: 最好的房间已经被订走了，我们只好接受次好的选择。

entries.en: The workers used a pulley to send down an empty bucket.
entries.zh: 工人们用滑轮把一个空桶送了下去。

entries.en: The network map shows the service area of each wireless access point.
entries.zh: 那张网络图显示了每个无线接入点的服务区。

entries.en: He was not slow-witted; he simply needed the instructions in a different language.
entries.zh: 他并不迟钝，只是需要用另一种语言写成的说明。

entries.en: Small fry gathered in the shallow water beneath the overhanging branches.
entries.zh: 鱼苗聚集在垂到水面上的枝条下方的浅水里。

entries.en: The farmer watched the cattle being led into a stock car.
entries.zh: 那个农民看着牛被赶进一节运牲口的火车车厢。

entries.en: The developer added a test case for an empty password field.
entries.zh: 开发者为密码栏为空的情况添加了一个检查实例。

entries.en: When the bucket is empty, you can throw in the loose stones.
entries.zh: 桶空了以后，你可以把那些散石头扔进去。

entries.en: After the match, the players met at their usual watering hole.
entries.zh: 比赛后，队员们在他们常去的酒馆碰面。

entries.en: She hung the wet blanket over two chairs to let it dry.
entries.zh: 她把湿毯子搭在两把椅子上晾干。

entries.en: The play depicts a witch-hunt fuelled by rumours of sorcery.
entries.zh: 那部戏描绘了一场由巫术传闻引发的搜捕行巫者的行动。

entries.en: He removed his tall plug hat before stepping into the low doorway.
entries.zh: 走进低矮的门口之前，他摘下了那顶高顶礼帽。

entries.en: The set of positive integer reciprocals has zero as a point of accumulation.
entries.zh: 正整数倒数构成的集合以零为聚点。

entries.en: She resented neighbours who tried to poke into her private affairs.
entries.zh: 她很反感那些试图探听她私事的邻居。

entries.en: The crew brought a powered post-hole digger to the fencing site.
entries.zh: 施工人员把一台动力桩穴挖掘机带到修筑围栏的现场。

entries.en: Press the pound sign after entering the extension number.
entries.zh: 输入分机号码后，按井号键。

entries.en: We used a heavy mortar to pound up the dried spices.
entries.zh: 我们用一个沉重的研钵把干香料捣碎。

entries.en: The powder compact cracked when it was lifted from the mould.
entries.zh: 那块粉末压块从模具中取出时裂开了。

entries.en: The storm interrupted power service to several streets near the coast.
entries.zh: 暴风雨中断了沿海附近几条街道的供电。

entries.en: A preliminary examination of the server logs revealed repeated connection failures.
entries.zh: 对服务器日志的预先检查发现了反复出现的连接故障。

entries.en: The tailor tried to press out the creases with a warm iron.
entries.zh: 裁缝试着用温热的熨斗把皱褶熨平。

entries.en: A paper jam stopped the printing unit halfway through the job.
entries.zh: 卡纸使印刷机组在任务进行到一半时停了下来。

entries.en: A notice warned that the footpath crossed private property.
entries.zh: 一则告示提醒人们，那条步道经过私有土地。

entries.en: His quick temper turned a minor disagreement into a noisy argument.
entries.zh: 他急躁的性情把一次小小的分歧变成了吵闹的争执。

entries.en: The disused railroad line runs behind the factory and across the river.
entries.zh: 那条停用的铁路线经过工厂后方，并跨过河流。

entries.meaningZh: 公安部门的刑事犯登记表
entries.en: His rap sheet listed earlier convictions for burglary and fraud.
entries.zh: 他的犯罪记录上列有先前因入室盗窃和诈骗而被定罪的记录。

entries.en: The camera recorded rapid eye movement during the tracking task.
entries.zh: 在追踪任务中，摄像机记录到了眼球的迅速跳动。

entries.en: She makes regular contributions to her retirement fund from each pay packet.
entries.zh: 她会从每份工资中定期拨出一部分，缴入自己的退休基金。

entries.en: The review article brings together findings from several studies of urban transport.
entries.zh: 这篇综述文章汇集了多项城市交通研究的发现。

entries.en: She put thin slices of cold roast beef into the sandwiches.
entries.zh: 她把冷烤牛肉的薄片放进了三明治里。

entries.en: The roast lamb arrived on a platter surrounded by baked vegetables.
entries.zh: 烤羔羊肉装在大盘里端了上来，周围摆着烤蔬菜。

entries.en: This old press can still roll off leaflets for the village fair.
entries.zh: 这台旧印刷机仍能为村里的集市印制传单。

entries.en: After serving on the council, she decided to run for mayor.
entries.zh: 在议会任职之后，她决定竞选市长。

entries.en: A saddle stitch fastens the booklet through its central fold.
entries.zh: 骑马订穿过小册子中间的折缝，把书页固定在一起。

entries.en: The fishing boat reached a safe harbor before the storm grew stronger.
entries.zh: 暴风雨进一步增强之前，那艘渔船驶入了一个避风港。

entries.en: Children enter secondary education at different ages within this school system.
entries.zh: 在这种学制下，孩子们进入中等教育的年龄各不相同。

entries.en: A coin was all he needed to scratch off the silver coating.
entries.zh: 他只用一枚硬币就刮掉了那层银色涂层。

entries.en: We managed to scratch up enough change for the bus fare.
entries.zh: 我们设法凑够了坐公交车的零钱。

entries.en: The inspection continued on the second deck, just below the upper deck.
entries.zh: 检查继续在第二甲板上进行，它就在上甲板下方。

entries.en: Checking visitor badges is a security measure, not a punishment.
entries.zh: 检查访客证件是一项安全措施，而不是惩罚。

entries.en: A sense of shame kept him from admitting how he had cheated.
entries.zh: 羞耻感使他不愿承认自己是怎样作弊的。

entries.en: She can serve well even when a strong wind blows across the court.
entries.zh: 即使强风横扫球场，她仍然能把球发好。

entries.en: The service staff cleared the tables after the last guests left.
entries.zh: 最后一批客人离开后，服务员清理了餐桌。

entries.en: He held a set square against the ruler to draw a right angle.
entries.zh: 他把三角板贴着直尺，画出了一个直角。

entries.en: The brass ship's bell hung above the entrance to the wheelhouse.
entries.zh: 那口黄铜船钟挂在驾驶室入口上方。

entries.en: They took turns to shovel in coal for the furnace.
entries.zh: 他们轮流用铁锨往炉子里铲煤。

entries.en: The stall sells fermented shrimp sauce in small sealed jars.
entries.zh: 那个摊位售卖装在小密封罐里的发酵虾酱。

entries.en: The new robot moves six times as fast as the old one.
entries.zh: 新机器人的移动速度是旧机器人的六倍。

entries.en: They reserved a snooker table for the club's evening tournament.
entries.zh: 他们为俱乐部晚上的比赛预订了一张司诺克台。

entries.en: The meter logged the sound pressure level during the engine test.
entries.zh: 测量仪在发动机测试期间记录了声压位准。

entries.en: She rested the soup ladle on a plate beside the pot.
entries.zh: 她把汤勺搁在锅旁边的盘子上。

entries.en: A spare tire lay beneath the luggage in the boot.
entries.zh: 一只备用轮胎放在后备厢的行李下面。

entries.en: A special contract covered the temporary loan of the theatre equipment.
entries.zh: 一份特定合同涵盖了那批剧院设备的临时借用。

entries.en: The hairdresser showed me a split end before trimming my hair.
entries.zh: 理发师修剪我的头发之前，给我看了一处开裂的发梢。

entries.en: The factory replaced its old spot welder after repeated breakdowns.
entries.zh: 那家工厂在旧点熔接机反复故障后更换了它。

entries.en: The rumour was quick to spread over the whole village.
entries.zh: 那条谣言很快就在整个村子传开了。

entries.en: He tried to stamp down the empty cardboard box with his boots.
entries.zh: 他试着用靴子把那个空纸箱踩扁。

entries.en: The controller records a state change whenever the door opens.
entries.zh: 每当门打开时，控制器就会记录一次状态变换。

entries.en: The charity helped a stateless person obtain identity documents.
entries.zh: 那家慈善机构帮助一名无国籍人取得了身份证明文件。

entries.en: One blow could stave in the rotten side of the barrel.
entries.zh: 只需一击，就可能使桶那腐朽的一侧向内塌陷。

entries.en: The program reserves a separate storage area for temporary results.
entries.zh: 程序为临时结果预留了一个独立的存储区。

entries.en: Her closing words strike a note of hope after the gloomy figures.
entries.zh: 在那些令人沮丧的数字之后，她的结束语传达出了一丝希望。

entries.en: A strobe light flashed above the stage during the final song.
entries.zh: 最后一首歌演唱时，一盏闪光灯在舞台上方频频闪烁。

entries.en: The student union voted to extend the library's weekend opening hours.
entries.zh: 学生会投票赞成延长图书馆周末的开放时间。

entries.en: The teacher identified the subjunctive mood in 'They insisted that he leave immediately'.
entries.zh: 老师指出了“They insisted that he leave immediately”（他们坚持要他立即离开）这句话中的虚拟语气。

entries.en: A suckling pig pushed between its littermates to reach the sow.
entries.zh: 一头哺乳期仔猪挤过同窝的小猪，朝母猪靠过去。

entries.en: The software relies on a support system that stores logs and recovery files.
entries.zh: 该软件依靠一个保存日志和恢复文件的支援系统。

entries.en: The harbour's surveillance system tracks the position of incoming vessels.
entries.zh: 港口的观测系统跟踪驶入船只的位置。

entries.en: A short chain connects the lamp to its suspension point.
entries.zh: 一条短链把灯与它的悬挂点连接起来。

entries.en: She reached for a brush to sweep off the crumbs.
entries.zh: 她伸手去拿刷子，想把碎屑扫掉。

entries.en: A new dance craze began to sweep over the country.
entries.zh: 一种新的舞蹈热潮开始风靡全国。

entries.en: A wave of applause began to sweep through the crowded hall.
entries.zh: 一阵掌声开始迅速传遍拥挤的大厅。

entries.en: The accountant spotted an arithmetic error during the tax assessment.
entries.zh: 会计在税收查定过程中发现了一处算术错误。

entries.en: A narrow path winds between the rows of shrubs in the tea garden.
entries.zh: 一条窄路蜿蜒穿过茶叶种植场内一排排茶树之间。

entries.meaningZh: 婴儿长牙时咬的橡皮环
entries.en: She found the baby's rubber teething ring under the sofa.
entries.zh: 她在沙发下面找到了宝宝长牙时咬的橡皮环。

entries.en: The log records the time of origin of each simulated signal.
entries.zh: 日志记录了每个模拟信号的起始时间。

entries.en: A small toothed wheel meshes with the larger gear inside the clock.
entries.zh: 一只小齿轮与钟内较大的齿轮相啮合。

entries.en: The physicist compared two estimates of the top quark's mass.
entries.zh: 那位物理学家比较了对t夸克质量的两种估计。

entries.en: The clerk checked the maturity date on the trade bill.
entries.zh: 职员核对了那张商业汇票上的到期日。

entries.en: She waited in the transit zone for the onward flight to begin boarding.
entries.zh: 她在过境区等候下一程航班开始登机。

entries.en: The new transmission system sends sensor data to the control room.
entries.zh: 新的传输系统把传感器数据发送到控制室。

entries.en: The diagram compares signal travel time along the two cables.
entries.zh: 图中比较了信号沿两根电缆传播所需的时间。

entries.en: The compiler must know which type of architecture the target processor uses.
entries.zh: 编译器必须知道目标处理器使用哪一种体系结构。

entries.en: The function's domain is an unbounded interval beginning at zero.
entries.zh: 该函数的定义域是一个从零开始的无界区间。

entries.en: The brochure describes an unsecured bond with no assets pledged as collateral.
entries.zh: 宣传册描述了一种没有资产作抵押的无担保债券。

entries.en: She packed the spare blankets into a vacuum bag to save cupboard space.
entries.zh: 她把备用毯子装进真空袋，以节省橱柜空间。

entries.en: Water leaked from a cracked water pipe beneath the kitchen floor.
entries.zh: 水从厨房地板下的一根开裂水管中漏了出来。

entries.en: They stood on the quay to wave off the departing crew.
entries.zh: 他们站在码头上，向即将出发的船员挥手送行。

entries.en: The committee discussed ways and means of reducing noise near the playground.
entries.zh: 委员会讨论了减少操场附近噪声的方法和手段。

entries.en: A single crack ran from one corner of the window pane to the other.
entries.zh: 一道裂纹从窗玻璃的一个角延伸到了另一个角。

entries.en: The cover was held in place by a wing screw with two broad tabs.
entries.zh: 盖板由一枚带有两个宽翼片的翼形螺钉固定。

entries.en: A small red light glowed near the aircraft's wing tip.
entries.zh: 飞机翼梢附近亮着一盏小红灯。

entries.en: After carrying boxes upstairs all afternoon, I felt completely wiped out.
entries.zh: 往楼上搬了一下午箱子后，我觉得自己精疲力竭。

entries.en: The scheduler assigns each work unit to an available processor.
entries.zh: 调度程序把每个工作单元分配给一个可用的处理器。

entries.en: The solver keeps intermediate results in working memory while the calculation runs.
entries.zh: 计算进行时，求解程序把中间结果保存在工作存储器里。

entries.en: The documentary had its world premiere at a small coastal film festival.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片在海边举行的一个小型电影节上进行了全球首映。

entries.en: The recognition program struggled with her cramped writing style.
entries.zh: 识别程序很难辨认她那种字迹密集的书写风格。

entries.en: The team kept a written record of every change to the design.
entries.zh: 团队用文字记下了设计的每一处改动。

entries.en: A wye divides the single pipe into two branches.
entries.zh: 一个Y形接头把一根管道分成两条支管。

entries.en: The vibrating screener separates small stones from the loose soil.
entries.zh: 振动筛把小石块从松土中分离出来。

entries.en: The team tested the parser's robustness with damaged and incomplete files.
entries.zh: 团队用损坏和不完整的文件测试了解析器的健壮性。

entries.en: The new pipework runs along the ceiling before entering the boiler room.
entries.zh: 新的管道组沿着天花板铺设，然后通入锅炉房。

entries.en: Her swain waited by the garden gate with a bunch of wildflowers.
entries.zh: 她的情郎拿着一束野花，在花园门口等候。

entries.en: The pub offers a shandy made with beer and ginger beer.
entries.zh: 那家酒馆供应一种用啤酒和姜汁啤酒调成的香迪酒。

entries.en: The novel's narrator calls the sanctimonious landlord a pharisee.
entries.zh: 小说的叙述者把那个假仁假义的房东称作伪君子。

entries.en: He apologised for calling his colleague a twerp during the argument.
entries.zh: 他为争吵时把同事叫作蠢货而道歉。

entries.en: I felt like a ninny when I discovered the key was in my own pocket.
entries.zh: 发现钥匙就在自己口袋里时，我觉得自己像个傻子。

entries.en: The club hopes to reacquire the land it sold years ago.
entries.zh: 俱乐部希望重新获得多年前卖掉的那块土地。

entries.en: She returned to the unfinished project with a purposefulness that surprised the team.
entries.zh: 她带着令团队惊讶的坚定意志，重新投入那项尚未完成的项目。

entries.en: The model shows the ship's underbody below the waterline.
entries.zh: 模型展示了船体位于水线以下的部分。

entries.en: She wrapped a striped woollen serape around her shoulders when the wind rose.
entries.zh: 起风时，她把一条条纹瑟拉佩羊毛毯披在肩上。

entries.en: The ragamuffin pulled a crumpled map from the pocket of a patched coat.
entries.zh: 那个衣衫褴褛的人从打满补丁的外套口袋里掏出了一张皱巴巴的地图。

entries.en: The old case was covered with rough sharkskin rather than woven cloth.
entries.zh: 那个旧盒子蒙着粗糙的鲨鱼皮，而不是机织布。

entries.en: The function returns a pointer to an unmanaged memory block.
entries.zh: 该函数返回一个指向非托管内存块的指针。

entries.en: The ferry crew served breakfast onboard before the vessel reached the island.
entries.zh: 渡轮到达岛屿之前，船员在船上供应了早餐。

entries.en: He called himself a waster after gambling away the money he had saved for rent.
entries.zh: 他把攒来交房租的钱赌光后，说自己是个挥霍者。

entries.en: A jammed roller brought the automatic packager to a halt.
entries.zh: 一个卡住的滚轮使自动包装机停了下来。

entries.en: Too many simultaneous requests can overstress the small server.
entries.zh: 过多的并发请求可能使那台小型服务器过载。

entries.en: The locked display case seemed designed to tantalise the children with toys they could not touch.
entries.zh: 那个上锁的展示柜仿佛就是要用孩子们碰不到的玩具让他们干着急。

entries.en: A local cattle raiser stored extra hay before winter.
entries.zh: 当地一位养牛人在冬季到来前多储备了些干草。
